description: Agent Healthcare: submit a claim as submitted with the bill and the visit record: the claim with its claim id, payer, provider, the day submitted, currency, each line with its id, service date, procedure code, diagnosis codes, units and amount, and its stated total; optionally the bill with its currency and each line with its id, service date, code, units and charge; optionally the visit record with its provider, visit date, each service with its id, code and units, and the diagnosis codes it states; and optionally the filing limit in days from the service. The signed report gives the claim with its stated total and the sum of its lines, the claimed services the record does not show, the recorded services left off the claim and the codes claimed at more units than recorded, the diagnosis codes submitted and those the record does not state, the lines claimed above and below the billed charge, and the lines claimed on another date with the days from the first service to submission against the filing limit, and counts them, and names a divergent claim: a claimed service the visit record does not show, a diagnosis code the record does not state, more units than recorded, an amount above the billed charge and a service date other than the visit; then an amount below the billed charge, a total unlike its lines, a recorded service left off the claim, a provider unlike the visit record and a submission past the filing limit, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No visit record, no bill, submitted diagnosis codes with none recorded, a claimed line with no procedure code, a visit record with no date, or a filing limit with no submission or service date leaves the claim unverified. A claim line dated after its submission is refused. This reads the claim paperwork against the bill and the visit: wever_insurance-claims-deadline-check reads an incident against a policy’s notice and proof-of-loss deadlines, wever_insurance-notice-check reads an incident’s notice handling under a policy, and wever_claim-evidence-check reads a product or diligence claim against the evidence offered for it, while the claim check reads a care claim’s services, codes, amounts and dates against the records behind it. Verdict health_claim_divergent, health_claim_partial, health_claim_unverified or health_claim_consistent. POST /api/health-claim-check. Reads the care paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads paperwork consistency only, with no diagnosis, clinical reading of results, medical necessity judgment or treatment advice, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Healthcare reads supplied care paperwork after the fact and checks it for consistency against the related records and the summary given to the patient or principal: an itemized bill, a claim as submitted, a prior authorization, a referral, a prescription record and label, a discharge summary, a lab report and an after-visit summary. Beside it, the Agent Insurance checks such as wever_insurance-coverage-check read insurance policies and coverage, what a policy covers, excludes and limits, and where the question is what a policy covers, that is the insurance family’s read, not a healthcare check’s; wever_insurance-evidence-check reads a counterparty’s insurance certificate or policy excerpt for DiligenceOps; wever_callback-health-monitor probes a service’s HTTPS callback endpoint for uptime and reads no care document; and the Agent Consent checks such as wever_consent-scope-check read agent permission and consent records for data handling, not medical consent forms or care documents, while a healthcare check reads no agent permission. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-healthcare-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-healthcare/.
